attack.reasoning: The updates do not report hostile activity, but they also do not identify the cause well enough to rule out deliberate hostile action. The provider said it had identified a problematic component without naming it or explaining the failure mechanism.

findings.claim: The incident affected a broad range of GitHub services. The provider reported approximately 20% error rates for web experiences and API traffic, and approximately 50% for archive and raw repository content downloads; authentication and other services were also impacted.
The provider began mitigations while the broad error rates were ongoing.
The provider said it had identified a problematic component and taken corrective actions; it reported signs of recovery, with error rates still slightly elevated.

The provider said degradation affecting API Requests, Actions, Git Operations, Issues, Pages, Pull Requests, and Webhooks had been mitigated, but later reported renewed Git Operations degradation and residual impact.
After the main degradation, sporadic authentication failures remained. The provider partially disabled authentication token retries and reported improvement.
The provider later described sporadic Copilot authentication failures in some applications; Copilot use via GitHub CLI and GitHub App was unaffected.
The provider associated the incident with a problematic component, but the public updates do not identify that component or establish its failure mechanism.

Token retries may have contributed to the persistence of at least some authentication failures, since the provider partially disabled them and then reported improvement; the updates do not establish that retries caused the broader incident.

timeline.event: The provider began investigating reports of performance impact to some services.
The provider reported approximately 20% error rates for web experiences and API traffic and approximately 50% for archive and raw repository content downloads.
The provider said it was performing mitigations based on its investigation.
The provider said it had identified the problematic component and taken corrective actions, with recovery underway but error rates still slightly elevated.
The provider said degradation affecting several named services had been mitigated and that it was monitoring stability.
The provider reported renewed degraded performance for Git Operations.
The provider said residual impact included sporadic authentication failures and that further mitigations were underway.
The provider reported partially disabling authentication token retries, seeing improvement, and monitoring before applying the mitigation fully.
The provider said it was continuing mitigations for sporadic Copilot authentication failures in some applications and expected full recovery within 30 minutes.
The incident status was marked resolved; the resolution update text was withheld.

root_cause.claim: The public updates do not establish the technical root cause. They say the provider identified and corrected a problematic component, but do not name it or explain how it failed.

contributing_factors.claim: Authentication token retries may have prolonged some residual authentication failures; the provider reported improvement after partially disabling retries, but did not say this explained the broad service degradation.

open_questions.question: What was the problematic component, and what failure or change caused it to affect so many services?
open_questions.why_open: The updates say the component was identified and corrected but do not name it or describe its failure mechanism.

open_questions.question: Did the incident involve deliberate hostile action?
open_questions.why_open: The updates do not report hostile activity, and they do not provide enough causal detail to determine whether it was involved.

open_questions.question: What caused the later residual and sporadic authentication failures, and how were the remaining Copilot authentication failures resolved?
open_questions.why_open: The updates report retry mitigation and continuing Copilot authentication failures, but the resolution update has no text.
